minimum_operational_condition: primary responsibilities for emergency response assigned across licensee, state, local, and support organizations
required_local_evidence: signed responsibility matrix; current authorities; 24/7 contacts; unresolved dispute/escalation path
failure_mode_if_missing: paper plan has named agencies but no owned actions or enforceable support path

minimum_operational_condition: onsite emergency organization, on-shift response, augmentation, command, and succession are real under degraded conditions
required_local_evidence: shift staffing roster; augmentation call test; command transfer record; fatigue and access constraints
failure_mode_if_missing: initial facility response depends on unavailable staff or unclear command

minimum_operational_condition: support resources, mutual aid, reception centers, monitoring teams, hospitals, transport, and specialized equipment are typed and exercised
required_local_evidence: resource inventory; mutual-aid agreements; reception center staffing; transport/hospital resource tests
failure_mode_if_missing: plans name resources that cannot arrive, staff, fuel, or operate in time

minimum_operational_condition: classification/EAL/PAR chain supports rapid, auditable protective-action decisions
required_local_evidence: EAL crosswalk; classification drill log; PAR issuance timestamps; decision review
failure_mode_if_missing: late or inconsistent classification delays public warning and protective action

minimum_operational_condition: notification to response organizations and public-warning activation procedures are redundant and time-tested
required_local_evidence: notification roster; alert activation time test; backup authority; failure-mode drill
failure_mode_if_missing: officials or public are notified too late, through a single brittle channel, or in inaccessible formats

minimum_operational_condition: onsite/offsite communication paths survive power, telecom, cyber, language-access, and rumor-pressure disruptions
required_local_evidence: radio/satellite/cellular/EAS/WEA/siren/door-to-door tests; JIC/JIS handoff log; backup power test
failure_mode_if_missing: command and public information fragment during the first hour

minimum_operational_condition: public education gives clear protective-action, KI, route, shelter, reentry, and rumor-control instructions before an event
required_local_evidence: plain-language materials; language/disability accessibility check; KI limitation language; annual public-info refresh
failure_mode_if_missing: people improvise, over-focus on KI, or cannot understand evacuation/shelter/reentry instructions

minimum_operational_condition: EOF/JIC/reception centers/monitoring/decon/shelter and field equipment are available, powered, calibrated, and staffable
required_local_evidence: facility readiness log; backup power/fuel; equipment calibration; access test; alternate site drill
failure_mode_if_missing: named facilities fail under weather, outage, access, staffing, or contamination stress

minimum_operational_condition: dose projection, field monitoring, plant data, meteorology, uncertainty, and decision logs support protective actions
required_local_evidence: dose-model provenance; meteorological feed; field-team data; uncertainty log; PAR feedback review
failure_mode_if_missing: protective-action advice rests on stale, opaque, or unchallenged model outputs

minimum_operational_condition: evacuation, shelter-in-place, KI-if-directed, staged evacuation, shadow-evacuation management, and food/water controls are operational
required_local_evidence: ETE/route evidence; shelter assumptions; KI authority; traffic control; food/water interdiction; special-population transport
failure_mode_if_missing: protective actions exist as choices but cannot be executed for real people and infrastructure

minimum_operational_condition: workers, responders, evacuees, reception centers, and shelters have dose control, contamination control, monitoring, and PPE protocols
required_local_evidence: dosimetry/PPE inventory; responder exposure limits; contamination control drill; decon queue model
failure_mode_if_missing: responders or public are harmed or unavailable because exposure controls are vague or unexercised

minimum_operational_condition: medical triage, decontamination, population monitoring, MCMs, hospitals, behavioral health, and special populations are integrated
required_local_evidence: hospital/EMS drill; population-monitoring layout; decon protocol; behavioral health staffing; special-needs registry protections
failure_mode_if_missing: KI stockpile masks lack of hospital, decon, biodosimetry, behavioral health, and registry capacity

minimum_operational_condition: reentry, relocation, cleanup, alternate water/food, health follow-up, claims, documentation, and public challenge are planned before the event
required_local_evidence: reentry criteria; relocation support; cleanup/waste path; dose/claims record design; public health registry; legal aid routing
failure_mode_if_missing: people receive early protective action but then lose housing, income, medical follow-up, trust, and claims evidence

minimum_operational_condition: full-scale, partial, functional, local, and off-hours drills expose failure modes and close corrective actions
required_local_evidence: exercise objectives; inject library; after-action closure log; retest evidence; independent evaluator notes
failure_mode_if_missing: exercise theater substitutes for corrective-action closure

minimum_operational_condition: licensee, ORO, first responder, hospital, shelter, public works, school, and support roles are trained and credentialed
required_local_evidence: training matrix; credential expiry; just-in-time refresh; role-specific drill performance
failure_mode_if_missing: plans assume people know roles that turnover, volunteers, contractors, and hospitals have not practiced

minimum_operational_condition: emergency plans, procedures, maps, contacts, demographics, source terms, and public materials are reviewed, distributed, versioned, and challenged
required_local_evidence: revision log; distribution proof; demographic refresh; route/map update; public comment/counterevidence ledger
failure_mode_if_missing: stale plan versions, outdated maps, and unreviewed assumptions survive with green status
